Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

Who We Are:

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world, moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview:

Our AI-driven pick-and-place and returns-handling cells combine robot arms, adaptive force-controlled grippers, AI vision and a safety cabinet, all driven by Cortex, our vision-language-action model. They run in live warehouse and logistics operations across the EU and US, and our deployed fleet is growing from around 50 cells to several hundred. Customer uptime now needs a dedicated owner. We're looking for a Director of Technical Support to build our customer-facing support function, covering everything from a customer opening a ticket to a cell back at target uptime. This is a player-coach role: you will stay hands-on technically while you hire the team and put the systems in place. You will work closely with our Hardware Product Engineering and Supply Chain leads.

Your Responsibilities:

Support Desk & Remote Diagnostics

  • Stand up the support desk, including ticket intake, triage, severity tiers, response and restore targets and an SLA framework

  • Define a coverage model for the EU and a plan for US time zones as the fleet grows

  • Build remote diagnostics on top of Cortex telemetry so most issues are triaged and fixed without a site visit

Escalation & Field Service

  • Run a closed escalation loop with Engineering, so field failures are triaged, root-caused and fixed in the product

  • Coordinate field service, including dispatch, on-site playbooks and third-party field technicians where needed

  • Identify the top recurring field failures and get them onto the product roadmap

Spares, RMA & Customer Enablement

  • Own the customer-facing RMA process and spare parts availability at customer sites, working with Supply Chain on procurement and logistics

  • Build customer onboarding, operator training, documentation and a knowledge base so customers can handle routine issues themselves

Metrics & Team

  • Own fleet uptime, MTTR, first-contact and first-visit resolution, SLA attainment and CSAT, and drive them up as the fleet grows

  • Hire and lead the first support and field engineers

  • Take front-line support duty off the founders and wider team

Qualifications:

Education and Experience

  • 8+ years in technical support, field service or after-sales for complex hardware, including several years leading teams

  • A track record of building a technical support, field service or after-sales function from scratch for a deployed hardware product as the installed base grew from tens to hundreds of sites

  • Hands-on experience setting up remote diagnostics and telemetry, ticketing and SLAs, escalation to engineering, spares and RMA, and field service coordination

  • Degree in mechatronics, electrical or mechanical engineering, automation or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Skills

  • Technical depth in mechatronics, controls or robotics, plus comfort working with software and telemetry data

  • Strong command of service metrics such as MTTR, uptime, SLA attainment and first-contact resolution

  • Calm, structured escalation management with customers and internal teams

  • Fluent German and English

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites

Additional Skills / Nice to Have

  • Experience in robotics, warehouse automation, AMRs or industrial automation, or in service for other deployed complex hardware such as energy storage, drones, medical or lab equipment, semiconductor equipment or machinery

  • Experience with IoT fleet monitoring or remote telemetry tooling

  • Experience running service coverage across the EU and US

  • Background in application or commissioning engineering

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity in a fast-growing Series B robotics company

  • Flexible PTO and a collaborative, high-ownership culture

  • Ownership of how our customers experience Sereact once their cells are live

Das heißt kurze Wege, direkte Wirkung und viel Verantwortung. Es heißt aber auch, dass du eigenständig arbeiten und priorisieren musst.

Aufgaben

  • Betreuung: Du betreust unsere Jahrgänge per Videocall, Chat und Telefon und bist für alles da, was über Chatbot und Helpcenter hinausgeht.

  • Projektbegleitung: Du begleitest jeden Jahrgang von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung, behältst Fristen und Freigaben im Blick und fasst nach, wenn ein Projekt hängt. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Operations-Team zusammen, das Produktion und Lieferung steuert.

  • Pipeline: Du hast deine Kunden eigenständig im Griff: Status, nächste Schritte, Risiken. Wo es eng wird, merkst du es vor dem Kunden.

  • Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und sorgst dafür, dass Chatbot und Helpcenter sie künftig beantworten.

  • Wachstum: Wenn du Lust hast, wächst du in Upselling und Referral hinein: Textilien für Jahrbuch-Kunden, Jahrbuch für Textil-Kunden, Schulshops und Empfehlungen an andere Jahrgänge und Schulen.

So arbeiten wir

  • Persönlich ist unser Unterschied. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt und stemmen oft ihr erstes großes Projekt. Sie brauchen jemanden, der erreichbar ist, mitdenkt und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird.

  • Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen.

  • Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich.

Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Support oder Customer Success gesammelt. Wie lange, interessiert uns weniger als das, was du daraus mitnimmst.

  • Du kannst mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache.

  • Telefon und Kamera schrecken dich nicht ab, im Gegenteil.

  • Du organisierst dich selbst und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Projekten den Überblick.

  • Du lieferst zuverlässig, auch wenn viel gleichzeitig läuft. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Tools und digitalen Kanälen.

  • Du erkennst, wenn ein Kunde mehr braucht, und sprichst es an. Vertriebserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind.

  • Du hast eine proaktive Haltung und arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.

Benefits

Unser Angebot

  • Du begleitest jedes Jahr Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt

  • Eine Rolle mit Perspektive: vom Support hin zu echtem Customer Success mit Upselling und Referral

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. title: Business Development Representative (m/w/d) - AI Agent Platform
description:
Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Worum es geht

Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %, und vor allem am Telefon.

Du bekommst Zielaccounts aus Branchen, die wir vorab festlegen, findest dort die Menschen, die das Problem tatsächlich haben, rufst sie an — und buchst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Account Executives. Nach dem Handover übernimmt der AE. Dein Ergebnis ist das stattgefundene, qualifizierte Gespräch, nicht der Abschluss und nicht der Kalendereintrag.

Der größte Teil unseres Geschäfts sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, dazu kommt ein solider Anteil Mid-Market. Innerhalb der Verticals, die für uns nachweislich funktionieren, gehen wir gelegentlich auch in größere Organisationen. Damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt: „Enterprise" heißt bei uns Unternehmen mit einigen hundert bis wenigen tausend Mitarbeitenden — nicht DAX-Konzern mit zweijährigem Beschaffungsprozess und Rahmenvertragsverhandlung.

Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu.

Dein Umfeld, ehrlich beschrieben: Unser Vertrieb arbeitet heute Full-Funnel. Die Account Executives machen neben allem anderen rund eine Stunde Outbound pro Tag. Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. Das heißt: Es gibt Erfahrung im Haus, an die du andocken kannst, und ein Playbook, das gerade entsteht. Welche Branchen wir angehen und mit welchen Kampagnen, verantworten unser Head of Sales und unser CRO. Dein Part ist das Gespräch, und was du dort hörst, fließt direkt in die nächste Runde ein.

Aufgaben

  • Telefon ist dein Hauptkanal. Cold Calling ist der Kern der Rolle, nicht ein Kanal unter mehreren. E-Mail und LinkedIn ergänzen die Ansprache

  • Ziellisten aus den Verticals abarbeiten, die Head of Sales und CRO festlegen. Die Listen kommen aufgebaut aus Clay und Cognism. Du priorisierst innerhalb der Liste und bereitest jeden Account kurz vor, bevor du anrufst

  • Kampagnen und Sequenzen in Lemlist setzen Head of Sales und CRO auf. Du führst sie aus und passt deinen Gesprächseinstieg im Call an dein Gegenüber an. Lemlist ist dein täglicher Arbeitsplatz, Clay und Cognism füttern ihn

  • Erstgespräche buchen, sauber vorbereiten und mit belastbarem Kontext an die Account Executives übergeben

  • Zurückspielen, was du im Markt hörst: welche Branche reagiert, welche Botschaft funktioniert, welche Einwände wiederkehren. Marketing und Sales-Leitung brauchen das

  • HubSpot sauber und aktuell halten — nicht als Selbstzweck, sondern weil Pipeline-Bewertung und Forecast darauf beruhen.

  • Enge Abstimmung mit Marketing und den AEs zu Kampagnen und Übergabekriterien

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 1,5 Jahre Outbound-Erfahrung im B2B, idealerweise SaaS oder erklärungsbedürftige IT-Lösungen. Du musst nicht alles gesehen haben, aber du solltest den Job kennen und nicht bei null anfangen — ein spürbarer Teil dieser Zeit sollte am Telefon stattgefunden haben und nicht nur in Sequenzen. Das ist keine Einstiegsposition.

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher auf muttersprachnahem Niveau (C2), Englisch mindestens C1. Beides täglich. Der Maßstab ist das Telefonat: Du führst auf Englisch ein Kaltgespräch, reagierst auf Einwände und hältst den Small Talk davor und danach aus, ohne dass die Sprache zum Thema wird. Wir hören uns das im Prozess an.

  • Du kannst nachvollziehbar erklären, warum deine Ansprache funktioniert hat — mit Zahlen und mit einer Begründung, nicht mit Bauchgefühl.

  • Du kommst mit Geschäftsführerinnen und Inhabern zurecht. Im Mittelstand hast du häufig direkt die Person am Telefon, die entscheidet — und die dir drei Minuten gibt, bevor sie wieder in den Betrieb muss. Erst in größeren Häusern sprichst du mit Fachbereichsleitungen und gelegentlich mit der IT.

  • Recherchefähigkeit: Du findest heraus, wer in einem Unternehmen ein Problem hat, bevor du zum Hörer greifst.

  • Selbstorganisation: Du strukturierst deine Woche selbst und brauchst keine tägliche Ansage, um in die Aktivität zu kommen.

  • Ein realistisches Verhältnis zu Ablehnung. Der größte Teil deiner Versuche führt zu nichts. Das ist normal und sollte dich weder überraschen noch aus der Ruhe bringen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM und Sales-Engagement-Tools. Unser Stack ist HubSpot, Lemlist, Clay und Cognism — genau diese Tools musst du nicht kennen, vergleichbare schon.

  • Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools. Recherche verdichten, Textvarianten durchspielen, ein Unternehmen vor dem Call in fünf Minuten verstehen — das geht heute schneller, wenn man weiß wie. Wir erwarten keine Zertifikate, aber auch niemanden, der ChatGPT einmal ausprobiert und wieder weggelegt hat.

  • Von Vorteil: Du hast schon aktiv nach Großbritannien akquiriert und kennst den Unterschied im Gesprächseinstieg. Ebenfalls hilfreich: Erfahrung mit Low-Code/No-Code-, ERP-, CRM- oder Datenbankthemen.

Formale Abschlüsse sind uns weniger wichtig als belastbare Outbound-Praxis. Wenn du das kannst, interessiert uns dein Studienfach nicht.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • 60.000 – 70.000 € Zieljahresgehalt (OTE) bei einem Split von 70 % Fixum und 30 % variabel. Der variable Anteil hängt an Kriterien, die du beeinflussen kannst, und ist erreichbar geplant. Den Plan legen wir vor Vertragsunterschrift offen.

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Produkt, ICP, Einwände und Gesprächsleitfäden in den ersten Wochen — plus regelmäßige 1:1s und Call-Reviews statt Zurufmanagement.

  • Kurze Wege. Du berichtest an Tim Genkinger, unseren Head of Sales, und hast direkten Zugang zu den Menschen, die über Produkt und Go-to-Market entscheiden.

  • 30 Urlaubstage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, BVG-Ticket und weitere Benefits.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro am Monbijouplatz in Berlin-Mitte.

You may come from an ERP implementation firm, Big 4 finance transformation practice, systems consulting team, or a SaaS company serving finance organizations. title: Senior RAMS Engineer
description:
We are looking for a RAMS Engineer to strengthen our safety and compliance team, with a particular emphasis on safety engineering for our vehicles, propulsion systems, ground infrastructure, and operations.

RAMS covers Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety. This role will apply those principles across the full lifecycle of complex hardware and operational systems, helping ensure that hazards are identified early, risks are controlled, and safety requirements are supported by clear technical evidence.

Although the role sits within safety and compliance rather than systems engineering, you will need a strong systems-engineering background and experience working with high-reliability, high-safety, or mission-critical systems.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and develop RAMS and safety-engineering processes across vehicles, propulsion systems, ground systems, facilities, and operations.

  • Define, manage, and verify reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety requirements throughout the system lifecycle.

  • Lead hazard identification, risk assessments, failure-mode analysis, fault-tree analysis, and other structured safety assessments.

  • Develop and maintain safety cases, hazard logs, RAMS plans, safety assessments, compliance evidence, and technical justifications.

  • Work with systems, propulsion, avionics, test, manufacturing, operations, and suppliers to identify hazards and implement effective risk controls.

  • Support design reviews, test-readiness reviews, operational-readiness activities, incident investigations, change control, and corrective actions.

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience in RAMS, safety engineering, reliability engineering, or systems engineering for high-reliability, high-safety, or mission-critical systems.

  • Experience analysing complex hardware and operational systems, including interfaces, failure modes, hazards, and system-level risks.

  • Strong understanding of safety-engineering methods and the ability to turn analysis into practical design and operational controls.

  • Experience producing clear technical documentation, safety arguments, risk assessments, compliance evidence, and engineering reports.

  • Strong communication skills, with the confidence to challenge technical decisions and work effectively with specialist engineering and operational teams.

  • A degree in systems engineering, safety engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

Desirable experience

  • RAMS or safety engineering within aerospace, space, defence, rocketry, missile systems, nuclear, rail, energy, automotive, or another high-consequence industry.

  • Experience with FMEA, FMECA, fault-tree analysis, hazard analysis, HAZOP, STPA, bow-tie analysis, or similar techniques.

  • Safety cases, functional-safety assessments, reliability predictions, maintainability analysis, or probabilistic risk assessment.

  • Propulsion systems, solid rocket motors, hazardous materials, explosives, test stands, launch operations, or high-energy systems.

  • Experience supporting verification and validation, qualification, acceptance testing, configuration control, and engineering change processes.

  • Familiarity with applicable aerospace, defence, functional-safety, quality, or hazardous-operations standards and regulatory frameworks.

  • Fluent German would be a significant advantage in this position.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

title: Operations Manager (m/f/d)
description:
About ALPAMI

At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 200+ keys across the Black Forest, Switzerland, Tirol, and Munich — spanning City Boutique Houses, Tiny Houses in Nature, and Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way.

We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast — with a clear target of 500 units next year. That means the operational engine behind our guest experience needs to scale just as fast, and that's exactly where you come in.

The Role

We're looking for an Operations Manager who reports directly to the MD and, from our Munich HQ, keeps the operational engine behind our guest experience running: you make sure our Customer Care team always has the relevant information at hand, support them in guest communication, and steer our local stakeholders on site. You are the nerve center of ALPAMI's day-to-day: the person who sees every property, every process, and every issue before it becomes a problem — and who fixes it before the guest even notices.

This is not a job for someone who wants a quiet 9-to-5. We're a fast-growing, founder-led company, and we need someone who understands what that actually means in practice: unpredictable days, fast decisions, and a genuine sense of ownership over the outcome. We expect high reachability, hospitality is a 365 day business. If you don’t agree with that, this might not be the right choice for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own operations end-to-end — surveil and continuously improve operational processes and management standards across our entire portfolio of properties

  • Be the single point of contact for our Customer Care team, provide them with relevant, up-to-date property information (access details, house rules, local specifics, open issues) so every guest gets a fast and correct answer

  • Assist with guest communication — step in on complex requests, special cases, and escalations, and help keep our tone and response times consistently on brand

  • Steer our local stakeholders on site — make sure the guest journey is smooth at every locationMonitor and act on operating room KPIs — occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest satisfaction scores, response SLAs, and the other numbers that tell you where to focus next

  • Carry out on-site visits in coordination with our Operations Lead whenever quality checks, partner onboarding, training, or problem-solving require an on-the-ground presence

  • Prioritize ruthlessly — you always know what needs fixing right now versus what can wait, and you make that call fast

  • Solve issues immediately — you're hands-on by nature and would rather fix something yourself in the next ten minutes than schedule a meeting about it next week

  • Lead and develop operational team members as we scale, setting the standard for how ALPAMI runs

  • Champion guest happiness as a non-negotiable core value — every decision you make is filtered through "does this make the guest experience better?"

What You Bring (Must-Haves)

  • 2–5+ years of experience in hospitality operations

  • Bilingual in German and English (spoken and written)

  • Strong written communication skills, clear, warm, and solution-oriented with guests, colleagues, and partners alike

  • A genuine hands-on mentality — you fix things yourself, immediately, rather than escalating by default

  • Strong prioritization skills and the judgment to resolve issues on the spot

  • Stress resistance, you stay clear-headed and effective when multiple things go wrong at once

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site visits to our properties

  • An understanding that joining a fast-growing company means flexible hours and a workload that doesn't always fit neatly into Monday–Friday, 9-to-5

  • Customer happiness as a core personal value, not just a KPI

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience leading a team

  • Experience in guest communication or customer care, ideally in hospitality

  • Deep technical understanding of hospitality tech tools (e.g. PMS, channel managers, guest communication platforms, revenue management systems)

  • Familiarity with AI, you don’t step away in challenge yourself and your workflows with AI

  • A driver's license

  • Experience opening new locations/properties

What We Offer

  • Direct reporting line to the Managing Director — your work has visibility and impact from day one

  • A front-row seat and real influence on our path to 500 units next year — you won't just support our growth, you'll be one of the reasons it happens

  • The autonomy of a founder-led, bootstrapped company: fast decisions, no bureaucracy, real ownership

  • The chance to shape what "operational excellence" means at ALPAMI as we scale

  • A team that believes 5-star experiences aren't about star ratings — they're about how we treat every single guest

  • A fair, competitive salary

  • A nice office in Munich

  • Frequent team events

  • Wellpass membership for your physical and mental well-being

  • AI & LLM Experience Design: Define user interactions for AI features (chat, automated reports, inline summaries), establish standards for insight attribution and uncertainty handling, and help refine the voice and structure of AI-generated content.
  • Design System Management: Own the principles and Figma library for the design system, partnering with frontend engineers to align with the React component library and establish robust data visualization and AI UX patterns.
  • UX Quality & Feedback Loops: Co-own product metrics, user feedback tracking, and quality evaluation rubrics for LLM outputs alongside the Frontend Lead.

Note: This position focuses strictly on product/UI/UX design. It does not involve writing production code, managing brand/marketing assets, or overseeing back-end API integrations.

Requirements

  • Qualifications
    • Experience: 3+ years of product design experience, ideally owning features end-to-end within a B2B or SaaS platform.
    • Product Thinking: Strong strategic perspective with a proven ability to define what to build and why, backed by a portfolio demonstrating strong problem-framing abilities.
    • Domain Focus: Experience designing data-heavy products, such as dashboards, analytics platforms, or reporting tools.
    • Design Systems: Proven track record of working within and contributing to scalable design component libraries.
    • Tools & AI Integration: High proficiency in Figma, with active integration of AI tools into day-to-day design workflows and a strong curiosity regarding LLM product experiences.
    • Communication: Excellent written English skills, capable of producing clear proposals and documentation in an asynchronous remote environment.
    • Schedule: Location within UTC−6 to UTC+1, with full availability during core collaboration hours (9:00 AM–12:00 PM EST).
  • Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
    • Experience as the founding or primary designer on a product team.
    • Hands-on experience building or evolving design systems adopted by engineering teams.
    • Direct experience designing AI features or creating evaluation rubrics for LLM output quality.
    • Expertise in advanced data visualization patterns.
    • Familiarity with consumer goods, beauty, food & beverage, or marketing intelligence platforms.
    • Capability to build rapid functional prototypes using AI-assisted tools to evaluate live outputs.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package tailored to experience.
  • Collaborative, high-impact environment with direct influence on core product direction.
  • Opportunity to work closely alongside senior design leadership.
  • Flexible starting timeline (target start date in January, with early onboarding available).

﻿

Interview Process

  1. Initial Video Screening: A brief introductory video conversation to discuss background, expectations, and role fit.
  2. Personality Assessment: An online assessment to evaluate working style and team dynamics.
  3. Design Leadership Interview: A 30-minute introductory chat with the Lead Designer.
  4. Screen-Recorded Case Study: A flexible, practical exercise (details currently being finalized) to demonstrate hands-on design methodology and execution.
  5. Final Interview: A concluding conversation with key stakeholders to review results and align on next steps.

You will understand how HR processes work end to end, identify opportunities to simplify and automate them, and turn business challenges into practical technology solutions.

Beyond gathering requirements, you will help build and deploy workflows, integrations and AI-enabled tools, while supporting Workday tech operations and process optimization in close collaboration with our internal Workday technology team and FlixTech.

The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and collaborates with HR process owners, People Operations, Workday Tech team, FlixTech, IT Security and Data Privacy teams globally. 

This role is based in Berlin (hybrid model). Given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.

About the Role

  • Analyze and optimize HR processes across the hire-to-retire lifecycle, working with People Operations and process owners to identify inefficiencies, conduct as-is/to-be gap analyses and translate requirements into practical Workday, automation and AI solutions
  • Support hands-on Workday operations and optimization, including approved HRIS transactions, organizational and position management, data maintenance, EIB uploads and functional testing, working within established security and governance frameworks
  • Design, build and maintain automation workflows using n8n, UiPath, Python and GenAI/LLM technologies, including MCPs, custom connectors, exception handling, monitoring and operational support.
  • Build and deploy AI-powered HR tools and internal applications, including Claude-based apps, with appropriate authentication, role-based access, data privacy and governance in collaboration with FlixTech and IT Security.
  • Drive business analysis and technical delivery from requirements and process design through prototyping, integration specifications, SIT/UAT, implementation and adoption, collaborating with Workday tech team on Workday configuration and technical integrations
  • Develop HR technology products and service-delivery solutions using Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Rovo Agents, improving employee and HR experiences through workflow automation, self-service and continuous product improvement

Most HR analyst roles stop at scoping requirements and handing them over. This one doesn't. You will keep Workday running for HR day to day, shape how our processes work in Workday, and build the automation and AI that removes manual work. You'll be the person the People function brings its problems to, and you'll help define how AI & Automation is adopted responsibly across HR at scale. 

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in HR technology, HR business analysis, HRIS or automation, with strong operational HR domain knowledge across the hire-to-retire lifecycle
  • Strong understanding of Workday Core HCM, business processes, organizational structures, security concepts and HRIS governance, including practical experience with Workday optimization, operational transactions, reporting, data maintenance or EIBs. description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

Research questions you could initially work on

  • Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control?

  • Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected?

  • Learning while controlling. How can we use dual control and active learning to choose actions that improve performance while gathering information about uncertain dynamics?

  • Learning across plants. Which parts of a model or control strategy can transfer between plants, and how can we adapt them efficiently to a new site?

These are meant as examples rather than an exhaustive list. We’re looking for someone who can bring depth to a relevant area, identify promising connections, and help us decide which problems to tackle next.

Your main responsibilities

As a Research Scientist, you’ll:

  • Help shape our research and development agenda, turning challenges from live plants into well-defined research problems.

  • Develop and implement methods for modelling, identification, optimisation and control of complex physical systems.

  • Design rigorous experiments, establish strong baselines and understand when and why a method works.

  • Work with process engineers to incorporate plant physics, operating knowledge and constraints into models and algorithms.

  • Work with machine learning and deployment engineers to evaluate promising methods and bring them into production.

  • Follow deployed performance, investigate failures, and use what you learn to guide further research.

  • Communicate your findings clearly and contribute to the team’s scientific understanding.

What a great fit looks like

  • A PhD in control, machine learning, applied mathematics, engineering, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

  • A strong research background in one or more of control theory, data-driven control, system identification, Bayesian optimisation, probabilistic modelling, physics-informed machine learning, imitation learning or model-based reinforcement learning.

  • Evidence that you can formulate a research question, develop a method and evaluate it carefully, through publications, open-source work or applied research.

  • Strong Python skills and experience implementing machine learning models using tools such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch.

  • An interest in working closely with engineers and taking responsibility for how your methods perform in practice.

  • Practical experience deploying machine learning and control algorithms.

  • A strong interest in climate mitigation.

You don’t need to know about cement. You do need to get excited about the physics, willing to learn from operators and process engineers, and keen to understand why a plant behaves the way it does.

We don’t expect you to tick every box. If you bring depth in a relevant area and these problems excite you, we’d like to hear from you.

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

description:
About Us

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

Tasks

What You’ll Be Doing

Content Audits & Quality Assessment
● Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
● Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
● Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

Content Strategy Development
● Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
● Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
● Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
● Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
● Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

AI & Agentic Discoverability
● AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
● Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
● Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

Testing & Performance Monitoring
● A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
● Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
● Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

Creative Briefing & Review
● Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and
marketplace advertising content.
● Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
● Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

Client Management
● Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.
● Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams.
● Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements.
● Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice.
● Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business.

Quality & Output Review
● Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
● Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy.

AI-Enabled Working
● AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy.
● Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team.

Requirements

What You Bring to the Role

● Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment.

● Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C.

● Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards.

● Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy.

● Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers.

● Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results.

● Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this.

● Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals.

Desirable

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of accurate and timely management accounts while remaining hands-on across accounts payable, fixed asset management, lease accounting, financial controls, and commercial analysis.

You'll be responsible for ensuring financial information is reliable, insightful, and delivered on time, whilst maintaining strong processes that keep the day-to-day finance operation running smoothly. Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare monthly management accounts, including profit and loss, balance sheet, and supporting schedules, to agreed deadlines.
  • Post and review accruals, prepayments, depreciation, amortisation, and other month-end journals; maintain clear supporting working papers.
  • Complete and review balance sheet reconciliations, investigate differences, and resolve outstanding items.

As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack.

This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production.

What You Will Do

  • Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses.

  • Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss.

  • Collaborate with the Inference Foundation team to integrate validated techniques into the vLLM-based serving stack.

Build the right tooling and validation platforms to facilitate AI-driven inference research.

What We're Looking For

  • Familiarity with the state of the art in LLM inference — you know what has been tried, what works, and where the open problems are.

title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
description:
📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite

Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques.

Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer.

Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse, vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites.

Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique.

Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance.

Vos missions

Votre rôle

Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite.

Vous êtes à la fois :

  • un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ;

  • un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ;

  • un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents.

Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre.

Vos principales missions

1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques

Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels.

Votre périmètre couvre notamment :

  • les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ;

  • les systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • les UPS / onduleurs ;

  • les groupes électrogènes ;

  • les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ;

  • les systèmes de refroidissement ;

  • la protection et la sécurité incendie ;

  • les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées.

Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations, et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques.

2 - Sécuriser les opérations

L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques.

À ce titre, vous :

  • challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ;

  • identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ;

  • sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ;

  • challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ;

  • pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ;

  • accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ;

  • contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification.

Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation, avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service.

3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques

L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites.

Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels.

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • structurer les processus d'exploitation ;

  • définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ;

  • rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ;

  • mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ;

  • contrôler leur bonne application ;

  • identifier les écarts entre les sites ;

  • proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ;

  • partager les bonnes pratiques ;

  • réaliser des REX multisites ;

  • accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards.

La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique.

4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques

En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations.

Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à :

  • analyser techniquement l'incident ;

  • identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ;

  • apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ;

  • challenger les analyses proposées ;

  • accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ;

  • contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ;

  • participer à la résolution de l'incident ;

  • organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites.

Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle.

5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle

Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation.

Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à :

  • former et accompagner les équipes ;

  • expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ;

  • faire progresser les pratiques ;

  • fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ;

  • accompagner la conduite du changement ;

  • favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites.

Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct.

6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs

Vous serez capable de :

  • représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ;

  • expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ;

  • présenter les actions mises en œuvre ;

  • répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ;

  • apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures.

Une organisation en construction

Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré, regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets.

L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec :

  • les responsables de site ;

  • les équipes projets ;

  • les experts techniques ;

  • les prestataires et partenaires externes ;

  • les fonctions transverses ;

  • les clients majeurs.

Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes.

Vos compétences

Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée.

Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées.

Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée.

Votre expertise technique

Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment :

  • électricité HT/BT ;

  • UPS / groupes électrogènes ;

  • CVC / HVAC ;

  • refroidissement ;

  • maintenance des infrastructures critiques.

Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes, et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial.

Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées.

Votre expérience opérationnelle

Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec :

  • les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • la gestion des changements ;

  • l'analyse de risques ;

  • la maintenance préventive et corrective ;

  • la gestion d'incidents critiques ;

  • les audits et contrôles opérationnels ;

Vous avez surtout envie de faire progresser une organisation, de structurer les pratiques et d'améliorer durablement les opérations.

Vos qualités

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, nous recherchons une personne :

  • à l'aise pour challenger ses interlocuteurs ;

Votre capacité à adapter votre communication à votre interlocuteur tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence technique sera déterminante.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. 3 premiers mois :

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Compétences requises

 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

 

- Tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

 

4 à 6 mois :

 

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

 

Et ensuite... :

 

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

 

Compétences requises

 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

 

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

3 premiers mois :

 

- Tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).
